title: Invite team
description: Full-viewport invite team screen composing the list block: an email field to invite teammates, then the invites nobody has accepted yet, with the send's error, invalid-address and busy states and the list's loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead, the send button and the continue row line up at @sm, the title grows and the footer lines up at @md.
